test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, L, X, Y and Z are sitting in a row, facing north. Only five people sit between B and L. Z sits to the immediate left of L. Only one person sits between Z and C. A sits at some place to the left of Y but at some place to the right of X.

Who sits third from the left end of the line?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, L, X, Y and Z are sitting in a row, facing north. 

1) Only five people sit between B and L.

2) Z sits to the immediate left of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77e59618bc7a73859a6f8ae02da4bce48cac911c4c27aea04150f73a88d59077.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89d37d2d3a448377511fab46a429712b7986fd3fded82fccc058f8b4631c8ebd.png] 

3) Only one person sits between Z and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6843b2d2e7c525fb667ad0ac0c6c7f417eef376f54ed98e999349f774d077b19.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/977b03d0157c95928afacdfaada694038b7366b188fc8dcbdd0a1de2de2fe53c.png] 

4) A sits at some place to the left of Y but at some place to the right of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a2212f2b633bff0bcb70c59a63d41476be68a2b3b70f77435705bb832354ab1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fd010a329ec8edb6b9b89bd4d0d4fa0869dae8a8b2321176eef702763c88f90.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, A sits third from the left end of the line.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
